name: Eclipse
description: Eclipse was a planet in the Deep Core of the galaxy that was hidden in an asteroid field. It was discovered by Tionne and Kam Solusar when they were looking for a safeworld for the Jedi. It was where Luke Skywalker created Eclipse Station during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
